text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, it's Super Creek. Mommy, I'm 
scared~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Rawr~ I'm gonna eat you up~♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: *giggle* *giggle*!

Along with Oguri Cap's popularity, Super 
Creek had also become completely famous.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, how are you feeling? What are 
your prospects heading into the Arima 
Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed~. Tama-chan and Oguri-chan are 
doing their best, but they still have a 
ways to go♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you struggle, you can't 
possibly win. Fufufu, this world belongs 
to me~♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So, jokes aside, what do you really think? 
How do you see this medium-to-long 
distance race at Nakayama playing out?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, haven't you been acting kind of 
strange lately?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm going out of my way to 
play the villain, everyone's being so cold 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Just what on earth is happening?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Creek! Look, look, over there!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. She's crazy fast, isn't 
she? And strong, too! Creek—!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: See?
choice_data_list:
Maybe my perspective is starting to 
change.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Point of view...? Why...?

At first, she was simply Oguri Cap's 
rival. But as her media exposure grew...

Super Creek's warm personality might be 
starting to reach people. Even among the 
more casual fans.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's quite complicated, isn't it? 
Though I wouldn't have minded playing the 
villain.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone has fun, that's all 
that matters.
choice_data_list: Maybe they're looking for a different role

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Something else...? You mean something 
that isn't a villain?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but still~ I'm pretty clumsy, you 
know, so I can't really do all sorts of 
fancy things.
choice_data_list:
I think another one is already done, 
though

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Another one? Trainer, does that mean...

"Everyone is starting to realize. Even 
without putting on an act, Super Creek is 
already a magnificent super athlete."

Heading into the final year-end showdown— 
the winds had begun to shift dramatically.
